jobs.title: Finance Internship
jobs.description_text:
Location: In-Person (New York, NY)

Compensation: $17.00 – $20.00 / hour

Commitment: 20-30 hours/week

 

About Eulerity

At Eulerity, we are building the future of AI-driven marketing automation. Our platform helps franchises and multi-location businesses manage digital advertising at scale using machine learning, automation, and data.

Behind that technology is a Finance team building the financial infrastructure to support a growing company. We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented Finance Intern to join our New York office and work directly with our Controller.

This is a hands-on role. You will work with real financial data, transactions, reconciliations, client media spend, reporting, and month-end close activities not just administrative tasks or theoretical exercises.

You will also gain exposure to how AI and automation can improve finance processes, reduce manual work, and analyze large datasets.

What You Will Do

  • Accounting & Operations: Support AP/AR, reconciliations, and day-to-day accounting while maintaining accurate financial data.
  • Media Spend Tracking: Reconcile high-volume media spend and learn how gross vs. net revenue works in an AdTech business.

CMM PROGRAMMER (2ND SHIFT)

Freeform is deploying software-defined, autonomous metal 3D printing factories around the world, bringing the scalability of software to physical production. Our proprietary technology stack leverages advanced sensing, real-time controls, and data-driven learning to produce digitally-verified, flawless parts at unprecedented speed and cost. Our mission is to make the transformative power of 3D printing available to all industries at scale and unlock the future of innovation.

You’ll also assist in maintaining inspection tools, documenting results, and continuously improving quality workflows. Over time, you’ll have opportunities to learn more advanced metrology tools and inspection methods in our growing lab. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about precision inspection, quality assurance, and continuous improvement, we’d love to hear from you!
